name: evtx.query_events
description: Query normalized Windows Event Log records for a case, with optional filters. Read-only.

channel.description: Filter to a specific EVTX channel, e.g. 'Security', 'System', 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational'.

event_id.description: Filter to a specific Windows Event ID, e.g. 4624 for a successful logon.

time_range.description: Filter events to this ISO-8601 time window.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the raw event XML.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.
